Council Meetings

Shire of Coolgardie Council Meetings for 2026:

Meetings of Council are held on the 4th Tuesday of the month at 6.30pm.

Meetings alternate between the Coolgardie Council Chambers, Bayley Street, Coolgardie and the Kambalda Community Recreation Facility Function Room, Barnes Drive, Kambalda.
